# Mahmud Elgoueri

> Systems and hybrid infrastructure engineer based in Tripoli, Libya. Works across
> on-premises Windows Server and Active Directory and Microsoft Azure / Entra ID:
> hybrid identity, Group Policy hardening, Active Directory security, and network
> segmentation. Publishes reproducible technical labs at mahmudeg.github.io/blog.

Personal site (`/`) and technical blog (`/blog/`) for Mahmud Elgoueri. The blog's
editorial rule is that every post is reproducible: it contains the actual commands,
configurations, and trade-offs rather than a summary.

## Profile

- Name: Mahmud Elgoueri
- Role: Systems & Hybrid Infrastructure Engineer at Electron Technology Solutions (June 2025 – present)
- Location: Tripoli, Libya
- Education: B.Sc. Electrical & Electronic Engineering (Telecommunications), University of Tripoli
- Languages: Arabic (native), English (professional working proficiency)

- Identity and directory: Active Directory DS, Group Policy design and auditing, hybrid identity, Entra Connect / Cloud Sync, Microsoft Entra ID

## Representative posts

- [Detect and Remediate an AD CS ESC1 Certificate Template](https://mahmudeg.github.io/blog/posts/deploy-hybrid-file-share-azure-file-sync/): finds the certificate template that lets any domain user request a certificate as Domain Admin, proves the exposure, and closes it by auditing templates with PowerShell, enabling CA auditing, and removing ENROLLEE_SUPPLIES_SUBJECT.
- [Configure DNS Aging and Scavenging on AD-Integrated DNS](https://mahmudeg.github.io/blog/posts/configure-dns-aging-scavenging-Copy/): enables DNS aging and scavenging safely — no-refresh and refresh intervals, per-zone aging, scavenging pinned to a single domain controller, and proof that stale records are removed.
- [Deploy a Group Managed Service Account (gMSA) for a Scheduled Task](https://mahmudeg.github.io/blog/posts/deploy-gmsa-scheduled-task/): replaces a static service-account password with a domain-managed gMSA, from KDS root key to a scheduled task running under it.
- [Windows Hello for Business in a Hybrid Environment](https://mahmudeg.github.io/blog/posts/windows-hello-for-business-hybrid/): Key Trust deployment with Azure AD MFA across hybrid Active Directory and Entra ID, including the blockers that break it in production.
- [Azure for the On-Prem Sysadmin: What Actually Changes](https://mahmudeg.github.io/blog/posts/azure-for-the-on-prem-sysadmin/): Azure explained for administrators coming from Windows Server and Active Directory.
- [Redundancy Protocols Lab: STP, HSRP, and VRRP in EVE-NG](https://mahmudeg.github.io/blog/posts/redundancy-protocols-lab/): failover behaviour of the three protocols compared in a multi-switch topology.
